title: Recent terrorist attempt bulletins

communications.subject: Washington Public Records Act Request: Recent terrorist attempt bulletins
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Bulletins and alerts generated, sent, or received mentioning the incident at RAF Fairford and/or the attempted hijacking of a FlyDubai plane between 26 September 2026 and the date this request was processed.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti

communications.subject: Texas Public Information Act Request: DRT NW Intel (Dimmit County Sheriff's Office)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

1. All messages, including text, images, attachments, voice notes, and associated metadata (sender, recipients, timestamps), sent or received by any [AGENCY ABBREVIATION] employee or official in the following WhatsApp group chats, and in any predecessor or successor versions of them, from January 1, 2024, through the date of your search:
- "DRT NW Intel 3.0"
- "NWHG 3.0"
- "ZAV-FRIO-SIU-UVA-MED"
2. Any other WhatsApp, Signal or text-message group chats from the same period that [AGENCY ABBREVIATION] personnel use to exchange information with U.S. Border Patrol or U.S. Customs and Border Protection personnel. For these chats, I request the group names, creation dates, and records sufficient to show which agencies participate.
3. Any policy, general order, memorandum or guidance in effect from January 1, 2024, to the present that governs [AGENCY ABBREVIATION] personnel's use of WhatsApp or other messaging applications for official business, and the retention of those messages.
4. Any agreement, memorandum of understanding, or task-force or Operation Lone Star document governing information sharing between [AGENCY ABBREVIATION] and U.S. Border Patrol in effect during the same period.

Messages on personal devices: Under Tex. Gov't Code § 552.002(a-2), communications about official business are public information regardless of the device or account used to create or maintain them. Employees and officials who hold such communications are temporary custodians under §§ 552.003(7) and 552.233, and must surrender or preserve them. Please search personal devices and accounts where personnel used them to take part in the chats described above.

Withholding: If you believe any portion of the requested information is excepted from disclosure, please release all portions that are not excepted, and request a ruling from the Office of the Attorney General within 10 business days as required by § 552.301. Please send me a copy of any such ruling request. I am not seeking officers' personal phone numbers or home addresses, and you may redact those without an Attorney General ruling where the Act permits.

Timing and format: Please produce the information promptly under § 552.221. If you cannot produce it within 10 business days, please certify in writing the date and hour it will be available. I request electronic copies in native format, or as screenshots or exports showing sender, timestamp and full content, delivered by email or file-sharing link. Please provide records on a rolling basis.

Preservation: Please notify the relevant personnel to preserve all responsive messages while this request is pending, including messages that WhatsApp's disappearing-message settings could otherwise delete.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Matthew Petti
